task: perihematomal edema (PHE) segmentation, PHE-SICH-CT-IDS SubdatasetA (CC BY 4.0), expert edema labels
split: patient-level: 112 geometry-matched patients (8 image/label affine-discordant excluded before training, not repaired), sorted, shuffled seed 20261021; 75 train / 37 test
model: UNetV2 (9 ch, 3 windows x 3 slices), input 160 from cached 256x256 arrays
sampling: all edema-positive slices + equal random negatives
checkpoint: final epoch, threshold 0.5, no test-based selection
evaluation: per-patient Dice, volume MAE/ICC/Bland-Altman on 40 test patients at cached 256x256 grid (in-plane downsampled); volumes use assumed-mm header geometry scaled to grid
amendment: 2026-10-21: first launch included discordant cases; stopped after <1 epoch, before any test evaluation; relaunched with exclusion
